top_signals.title: Oil Gains With Iran in Focus, CoreWeave Rallies: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Crude oil posted a modest gain as traders remained wary over the prospects for a Middle East deal, tempering the mood ahead of crucial US inflation data. Sentiment toward technology stocks remained buoyant, with CoreWeave Inc. shares surging after the company bolstered its outlook.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Singapore Exchange Eyes Single-Stock ETFs, Tie-Ups for Growth
top_signals.summary: Singapore Exchange Ltd. is exploring offering a broader suite of exchange-traded funds and stepping up partnerships across markets as it seeks to bolster its position as Southeast Asia’s key multi-asset exchange.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Colombia to declare economic emergency as quake toll tops 180
top_signals.summary: An emergency order would give the country's new president temporary authority to issue economic and tax decrees without the need for congressional approval.
